annotation.bound_parties_text: The SAE Recommended Practice binds no one; it provides metrics, and implementers choose the values for the quantities used.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: In the interim, it will be the responsibility of the implementer of these metrics to choose values for these quantities.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This SAE Recommended Practice provides DA metrics used to quantify the DDT performance of ADS-operated vehicles.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This SAE Recommended Practice provides DA metrics used to quantify the DDT performance of ADS-operated vehicles.
